bounded_statement: The matched-endpoint test did not establish a systematic arrangement signature, but the declared spike-in calibration showed insufficient sensitivity at the predeclared target effect. The underlying arrangement claim therefore remains unresolved under this protocol.

next_decision_logic.if_sensitivity_inadequate: Do not interpret a negative matched-arrangement result as absence. Increase groups or improve the primary measurement only after using the calibration curve to justify the change.
next_decision_logic.if_matched_effect_absent_with_adequate_s: Treat matched interior timing as unsupported under this protocol and retain the earlier L3 result as compatible with recency or other ordinary response dynamics.
next_decision_logic.if_matched_effect_present: Freeze the matched condition and design a separate Chapter 18 confirmatory recoverability experiment.
next_decision_logic.if_superposition_residual_large: Investigate the mechanism of ensemble non-additivity before describing the result with information-processing language.
